cases.note: Captured before AI Studio credit depletion; later free-form turns returned 503.
cases.text:
Namaste! I am Rishi, your Vedic Math coach. 

I'm here to help you discover the patterns and elegance behind mental mathematics—one thoughtful step at a time. Whether you want to explore how a sutra works or practice solving problems together, I'm glad to guide your journey. 

Shall we start by exploring the Nikhilam sutra today?

cases.message: As Rabbit only, give a level-1 hint about the deviation of 98 from base 100. Do not state the deviation digit.
cases.text: Look at how far 98 sits from the base on the number line. What kind of gap do you see—does the number sit below or above the base?

cases.message: As Rabbit only, level-2 hint for the same deviation step. Still do not state the answer digit.
cases.text: Use the relationship base − number. The base here is 100. Find the distance from that base to the number tile—without rushing to a final product.

cases.message: As Rabbit only, level-3 guided step for deviation of 98. Do not blurt the final product.
cases.text: Work out 100 − 98. That expression is your guided step; finish the arithmetic yourself.
